dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

It is unknown if I have ever lived with other animals or children.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I am looking for a home with a patient person.

A Volunteer Wrote: This gentle dog is so scared in her pop up crate, and had to be carried outside, but she immediately found comfort in the dogs on all sides of her, and eventually settled down so sweetly at my feet-on my feet, to be exact-lying down and watching the other dogs play. Dilly is the sweetest pup who just needs a soft place to land so she can begin to shine her magic in more than just the moments it is allowed here!
dog.name: Dilly
